shots.title: Keep the coffee?
shots.subtitle: Give your spending a purpose.
shots.voice: What if your coffee is worth keeping?

shots.title: Four dollars every day
shots.subtitle: 365 days × $4 = $1,460 a year
shots.voice: Four dollars daily becomes fourteen sixty yearly.

shots.title: Price is only half the story
shots.subtitle: What does it add to your day?
shots.voice: The price alone does not tell the whole story.

shots.title: Your morning ritual
shots.subtitle: A pause before the day starts.
shots.voice: Maybe it is your morning ritual.

shots.title: Look at the trade-off
shots.subtitle: Compare what matters to you.
shots.voice: Compare that ritual with something else you want.

shots.title: One illustrative alternative
shots.subtitle: $2 less each day, kept for experiences
shots.voice: Two dollars less keeps seven thirty yearly.

shots.title: Spend with intention
shots.subtitle: Enjoy today. Keep tomorrow in view.
shots.voice: Choose deliberately. Your money should support your life.
